root: Uni-CLI 0.226.0 makes browser automation identity continuous by default: commands first attach to a process-verified logged-in Chrome profile when CDP is already exposed, otherwise they seed a Uni-CLI-owned automation profile from the preferred local Chrome profile.

Chrome 136's default-profile CDP block remains enforced; Uni-CLI never launches remote debugging against the real default user-data-dir and reports unknown CDP listeners instead of silently reusing them.
The browser doctor, status, and profiles surfaces now report whether the current path is attach, seeded, remote, or explicit ephemeral, including seed freshness and empty-profile warnings.
A new browser-auth acceptance probe checks decrypted persistent-cookie parity between the real profile and seeded automation profile without printing raw cookie values.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.226.0 默认让 browser automation 延续用户登录态：已有 process-verified CDP 的真实登录 Chrome 会被优先 attach，否则会从首选本地 Chrome profile 播种 Uni-CLI 自有 automation profile。
Chrome 136 对 default profile 的 CDP 限制继续硬拦截；Uni-CLI 永远不会对真实默认 user-data-dir 启动 remote debugging，也不会静默复用未知 CDP listener。
browser doctor、status、profiles 现在会显示当前路径是 attach、seeded、remote 还是显式 ephemeral，并暴露 seed freshness 与空 profile warning。
新增 browser-auth acceptance probe，在不打印 raw cookie value 的前提下校验真实 profile 与 seeded automation profile 的 decrypted persistent-cookie parity。
